scope.writeConstraint: Only this report file was written; question banks, source catalog, scripts, tests, and existing audit logs were not edited.
scope.reviewRule: High-confidence defects are recorded item-by-item. Repeated frames with materially different question text are not treated as duplicates.

methodology: Read every question, option array, keyed zero-based index, explanation, topic/subtopic, and sourceId in both files.

Checked whether the keyed option answers the stem, whether the explanation supports that key, whether distractors remain plausible and distinct, and whether the item fits its assigned official A1 area.
Compared exact question text and exact text/options/key tuples across both files.
Checked option-length thresholds using correct-option length versus median distractor length and maximum option spread.

Inspected the local source catalog, the local SAI notification syllabus pages, the two research source notes, and relevant text/contents in the supplied Kinesiology, NSCA, and Physiology books. External URLs named in the catalog/research notes were not treated as independently inspected during this audit.

inspectedMaterials.scope: Source IDs, declared source kinds, scopes, locators, and local paths.
Official A1 area mapping, book metadata/locators, and provenance notes.
Local text extraction of PDF pp. 19–22 for official A1 scope; relevant detailed syllabus references also appeared in the supplied PDF's discipline sections.
Text extraction around printed biomechanics/instrumentation material, including force, kinematic, video, and external-force measurement context.
